evidence: The startup copy maps each AP descriptor into initialized SRAM. Its name pointer, page and app halfwords, and creation callback match the independently analyzed page creation function and language/UI path. Navigation implementations load action +4 as the combined page target and action +6 as the app identifier. These IDs are initializer values, not observations of live registered descriptors.
